newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Oct 2.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Oct. 2:
WASHINGTON - Cigarette manufacturer Philip Morris Cos. faces lawsuits filed by nine women alleging they were sexually harassed at the firm's Louisville plant.

WASHINGTON - The long-running A-12 fiasco - the fighter plane that was never built - is expected to bring two companies $750 million each in damages when a judge rules soon in a lawsuit over the aircraft's cancellation.

WASHINGTON - Supporters of organised labour are trying to force Congress to drop a last-minute amendment to the Federal Aviation Reauthorization Act that would ensure Federal Express Corp. remains covered by the Railway Act.
